author: hyuccc
body: Nice one mods, you ban my friend. You thought he was my account, and because i got banned, you banned him for ban evasion. If you dont know the whole story, I let my friend use my laptop for school purposes for about a week or so because his was broken down. I didn't know he would play avicus, but i guess on his spare time he logged into his account. Now he is mad at me because he thinks i was the reason he was banned. Well technically i am, but thats not the point. I will ask you nicely to unban him, as he just told me this yesterday as i got my computer back. And you think i would make another account, donate for diamond on it, and play on that. Lol. Well, his name is Tekn. I think you know the reason why he should be unbanned.
